name: wafw00f
label: wafw00f
description: wafw00f: is the URL behind a web application firewall, and which one? Sends a few attack-looking test strings to make a WAF show itself. Never follows redirects.
contacts: 2 to 7 HTTP GET requests to {target}: normal ones, one with a script's User-Agent, and some whose query string carries attack-looking test strings (an XSS <script>, a SQL injection with SLEEP, ../../etc/passwd) to make a WAF block them; nothing is exploited; redirects are not followed
